title: C++: Observer Pattern
description: Implement the Observer pattern with a Subject that notifies multiple Observers.

steps.title: Observer Pattern
steps.description: Define an Observer interface with virtual void update(int state). Implement concrete observers: `LogObserver` prints state and `AlertObserver` prints alert if state > 10. Create a Subject class that maintains a list of observers and notifies them on state change.
hints: Subject: vector<Observer*> observers; void attach(Observer* o) { observers.push_back(o); }
void setState(int s) { state = s; notify(); }
void notify() { for (auto o : observers) o->update(state); }

verification.failureMessage: Notify both observers with states 5 and 15
